**Thinking about "Day of the Dead" references**

I’m associating various elements with "Day of the Dead." The connection of A10 with D5 brings that to mind. A yellow one, plus one? That makes two, so I wonder if it relates to a sequel, like “Day of the Dead 2” or maybe “Death at a Funeral.” I think of films like "The Seventh Seal" and "Live and Let Die," and there’s also “Happy Death Day” that plays with death and birthdays, much like “Groundhog Day.” So, I’m leaning towards “Happy Death Day” or “Groundhog Day.”
